authors: L. J. Dixon, O. Gurdogan, A. J. McLeod, M. Wilhelm
title: Bootstrapping a stress-tensor form factor through eight loops
claim: Three-point form factor of the chiral stress-tensor multiplet in planar N=4 SYM bootstrapped at six, seven and eight loops using form-factor OPE boundary data and new adjacency restrictions; possibly the highest perturbative order for a multi-variable quantity in a unitary 4d QFT (hedged); led to the discovery of antipodal duality with the six-gluon amplitude; via maximal transcendentality expected to give the top-weight part of H -> ggg in QCD (heavy-top limit).
scheme: bootstrap, no loop integration; finite (normalized) form factor
symmetry_argument: function-space ansatz + form-factor OPE (integrability-based boundary data) + adjacency constraints

assumed: maximal transcendentality for the QCD application
checked_partially: numerical evidence for finite radius of convergence

red_flags: bootstrap results rely on assumed function spaces and integrability input; not tests of DR
